## How to read this

Jobs here are **long-lived workers**, not one job per structure. Each pulls tasks
from a shared flock'd queue (`bin/wq.py`), so a job's 'structure' column is the set
of queue tags it served and the count of runs it completed. The per-run mapping is
in section 2, from the `provenance.txt` stamp each worker writes into the run
directory before starting RASPA. Runs predating that stamp read `pre-stamp`.
